孟子跟他的老师从早到晚学习，难怪他的成绩很快就进步了很多。孟子学习的时候，孟子的妈妈不是待在家里就是编织衣服赚钱。以后孟子成为了中国有名的哲学家。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 以后：后来，Sentence-initial “以后” cannot independently mean “afterwards” in a narrative; “后来” introduces a later event. [vocab list]
Run 2: 以后孟子成为了中国有名的哲学家：后来孟子成为了中国有名的哲学家，At the beginning of a sentence, “以后” does not mean “afterwards” in a past narrative; use “后来” to introduce a later event. [vocab list]
Run 3: 以后：后来，At the start of a sentence, use this word to introduce a later event in the narrative; the original word is not used alone with this meaning. [vocab list]
